title: Design: Notes tab shows the system note after Convert to Billable
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have a new work order for the regular customer, with one labor line (1.0 h) and one stock part with a cost, converted to No Charge with the category Goodwill, made for this test.
  • Convert that work order to billable (three-dots menu > Convert to Billable).
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow2-09-3e-notes-after-convert-to-billable.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Click the Notes tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens with prices on its lines.

Step 2:

  • A read-only note by ShopView reads "Every line priced as a new line would be today. Category Goodwill removed." in the wording of the PRD, above the earlier Convert to No Charge note.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R18: “Every classification change writes a read-only system note on the work order (Notes tab, author ShopView, with the user and the time) and an Audit Log row: Convert to No Charge ("Converted to No Charge by [user]. Category [name], original work order [number]. Prices, fees and discounts removed; costs and hours kept."), Change category (from, to, original work order kept or cleared), Convert to Billable ("Every line priced as a new line would be today. Category [name] removed."), Close (posting date, account), Reopen, and the line actions of Story 12 (S12-R6).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: page "Flow 2 · No charge on a customer's work order", board "3e Notes · after Convert to Billable" (Flow 2 · No charge on a customer's work order).
